note: Web searches of 19/11/2026 for the dossier places whose outcome the data alone could not settle, and for a sample of the others. Findings are summaries of the search results; links are the sources returned. No finding was used to rank or remove a zone.

searches.query: Carbonita Serro Espinhaço Minas Gerais quartzite ridges relief geology
searches.finding: Southern Espinhaço Range: quartzitic sequences of the Espinhaço Supergroup; no source describes the relief of these exact zones.

searches.query: MacDonnell Ranges Northern Territory 24°S 134°E geology terrain ridges
searches.finding: MacDonnell Ranges: parallel quartzite and sandstone ridges rising from a plateau; the zone lies east of the reported range centre, near the East MacDonnell Ranges (inference, not stated by the sources).

searches.query: Adams County Iowa Quincy township terrain loess hills cropland
searches.finding: Southern Iowa Drift Plain; about 79% of the county is cropland.

searches.query: Afyonkarahisar Sinanpaşa volcanic plateau geology relief
searches.finding: Neogene basin at about 1,115 m ringed by mountains, volcano-sedimentary fill; tuff plateaus and mesas nearby.

searches.query: San Juan County Utah 38.4N 109.1W canyons mesas Paradox Basin geology
searches.finding: Paradox Basin: canyons, mesas, buttes and hogbacks; the sources do not place a feature at these coordinates.

searches.query: Kolyma Srednekolymsk lowland upland relief permafrost geomorphology 67N 158E
searches.finding: Kolyma Lowland: flat alluvial plains with residual ridges, yedoma and alas thermokarst relief.
